description: Finds all callers of a specific function in a V8 CPU profile and returns how often each caller invoked it. Accepts partial, case-insensitive function name matching. Use to answer: what is calling my slow function and how many times?

function_name.description: Function name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive)

top_callers.description: Number of top callers to return (default: 5)

name: analyze_call_tree_path
